name: sentinel_final
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/sentinel_final; mkdir -p $O
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot sentinel --out $O --stage sculpt --fine --shots $O/shots > $O/sculpt.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/sculpt.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot sentinel --out $O --stage game --tex 2048 --ao 24 > $O/game.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/game.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot sentinel --out $O --stage export > $O/export.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/export.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_icon.py -- $O/sentinel_hq.blend $O/icon_sentinel.png --frame 8 > $O/icon.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/icon.log
python3 _dc_views.py -- $O/sentinel_hq.blend $O/views Walk:0,17,3:-30,45 Walk:0,0,1:0,10 Walk:0,0,1:90,10 > $O/views.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/views.log
ls -la $O

name: the_core_final
cmd:
O=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/the_core_final; mkdir -p $O
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot the_core --out $O --stage sculpt --fine --shots $O/shots > $O/sculpt.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/sculpt.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot the_core --out $O --stage game --tex 2048 --ao 24 > $O/game.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/game.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_build.py -- --robot the_core --out $O --stage export > $O/export.log 2>&1 || (tail -40 $O/export.log; exit 1)
python3 robot_icon.py -- $O/the_core_hq.blend $O/icon_the_core.png --frame 8 --margin 0.12 > $O/icon.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/icon.log
python3 _dc_views.py -- $O/the_core_hq.blend $O/views Walk:0,45,6:-30,45 Emp:20,32,2:-30,40 Summon:6,24,3:-35,35 Enrage:0,24,3:-30,40 WalkRage:0,0,1:-30,45 Walk:0,0,1:0,60 > $O/views.log 2>&1 || tail -20 $O/views.log
ls -la $O
